import L5Model

namespace L5

set_option maxRecDepth 100000

/-! Certificate for the impossibility bound (generated by work/gen_cert.py; checked here by the kernel). -/

inductive Tree
  | leaf
  | node (l : Tree) (key : Nat) (s : PS) (d : Int) (r : Tree)

def Tree.lookup : Tree → Nat → PS → Option Int
  | .leaf, _, _ => none
  | .node l k s0 d r, key, s =>
    if key < k then l.lookup key s
    else if k < key then r.lookup key s
    else if s0 = s then some d else none

def Tree.toList : Tree → List (PS × Int)
  | .leaf => []
  | .node l _ s d r => l.toList ++ (s, d) :: r.toList

theorem Tree.lookup_mem : ∀ (t : Tree) (key : Nat) (s : PS) (d : Int),
    t.lookup key s = some d → (s, d) ∈ t.toList := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf => intro key s d h; simp [Tree.lookup] at h
  | node l k s0 d0 r ihl ihr =>
    intro key s d h
    simp only [Tree.lookup] at h
    split at h
    · exact List.mem_append_left _ (ihl _ _ _ h)
    · split at h
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ihr _ _ _ h))
      · split at h
        · rename_i heq
          subst heq
          simp at h
          subst h
          simp [Tree.toList]
        · simp at h

def Dir.idx : Dir → Nat | .U => 0 | .D => 1 | .L => 2 | .R => 3
def b2n (b : Bool) : Nat := if b then 1 else 0

def enc (q : PS) : Nat :=
  (((((q.t*64+q.l)*8+q.s)*4+q.f.idx)*2+b2n q.co)*2+b2n q.dO)*2+b2n q.pk

def allActs : List Act :=
  [.mv .U, .mv .D, .mv .L, .mv .R,
   .mvk .U .k1, .mvk .U .k2, .mvk .U .k3, .mvk .U .k4, .mvk .D .k1, .mvk .D .k2, .mvk .D .k3, .mvk .D .k4,
   .mvk .L .k1, .mvk .L .k2, .mvk .L .k3, .mvk .L .k4, .mvk .R .k1, .mvk .R .k2, .mvk .R .k3, .mvk .R .k4, .shrink, .six, .tele, .grow,
   .shrinkAt .c0, .shrinkAt .c1, .shrinkAt .c2, .shrinkAt .c3,
   .growAt .o0 .o0, .growAt .o0 .o1, .growAt .o0 .o2, .growAt .o1 .o0, .growAt .o1 .o1,
   .growAt .o1 .o2, .growAt .o2 .o0, .growAt .o2 .o1, .growAt .o2 .o2]

theorem mem_allActs (a : Act) : a ∈ allActs := by
  cases a with
  | mv d => cases d <;> simp [allActs]
  | mvk d k => cases d <;> cases k <;> simp [allActs]
  | growAt a b => cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [allActs]
  | shrinkAt c => cases c <;> simp [allActs]
  | _ => simp [allActs]

/-- energy weight of a macro: 9 per click (0.9 unit) + 10 per completion (1 unit), in tenths. -/
def wt (a : Act) : Int := 9 * (clicks a : Int) + 10 * (comps a : Int)

inductive CTree
  | leaf (t : Tree)
  | node (hi : Nat) (l r : CTree)

def CTree.lookup : CTree → Nat → PS → Option Int
  | .leaf t, k, q => t.lookup k q
  | .node hi l r, k, q => if k ≤ hi then l.lookup k q else r.lookup k q

def CTree.leaves : CTree → List Tree
  | .leaf t => [t]
  | .node _ l r => l.leaves ++ r.leaves

theorem CTree.lookup_mem : ∀ (c : CTree) (k : Nat) (q : PS) (d : Int),
    c.lookup k q = some d → ∃ t ∈ c.leaves, t.lookup k q = some d := by
  intro c
  induction c with
  | leaf t => intro k q d h; exact ⟨t, by simp [CTree.leaves], h⟩
  | node hi l r ihl ihr =>
    intro k q d h
    simp only [CTree.lookup] at h
    split at h
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, h'⟩ := ihl k q d h
      exact ⟨t, by simp [CTree.leaves, ht], h'⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, ht, h'⟩ := ihr k q d h
      exact ⟨t, by simp [CTree.leaves, ht], h'⟩

def look (q : PS) : Option Int := ctop.lookup (enc q) q

def chk (e : PS × Int) : Bool :=
  allActs.all fun a =>
    let r := pstep T4 T2 e.1 a
    let bonus : Int := 90 * ((b2n r.1.pk : Int) - (b2n e.1.pk : Int))
    if r.2 then decide (e.2 ≤ wt a - bonus)
    else match look r.1 with
      | some d' => decide (e.2 ≤ wt a - bonus + d')
      | none => false

end L5
